column1: # Ash Jenna's automatic post-Manticore confrontation. No recruitment choice.

column3: You again, Isaac.\nI'm surprised the desert\ndidn't finish you.{end_wait}
You've been watching me.\nTell me who you are.{end_wait}
Still fighting, Isaac?\nSome things never change.{end_wait}
How do you know me?\nYou look just like Jenna.{end_wait}
My name is Jenna, too.\nCall me Ash Jenna.{end_wait}
What? That's impossible.\nWe grew up with Jenna.{end_wait}

I grew up in Vale, too.
I knew an Isaac and
a Garet.{page_break}Not you two.
The ones from my world.{end_wait}
Your world?\nYou mean there's\nanother one like ours?{end_wait}
Then what happened\nto your Vale?{end_wait}
{end_wait}
The beacons were lit.\nMy world was destroyed.{page_break}I watched it happen.\nI had nowhere left to go.{end_wait}
Why come to us?\nWhat do you want?{end_wait}

You still have a home.
You still have friends.{page_break}I wonder how long
they'll keep following
you, Isaac.{end_wait}
Isaac, she knows things\nshe shouldn't. But that\ndoesn't prove her story.{end_wait}
Believe what you like.\nI don't need you to.{end_wait}
We're looking for Jenna.\nHave you seen her?{end_wait}

You can't watch
over all of them
forever.{page_break}Remember that when
one of them is missing.{end_wait}
She's not going to tell us.\nCome on, Isaac.{end_wait}
We still have to find\nJenna and Kraden.{end_wait}

Walking away already?
Fine. Go.{page_break}I'll be there when
something finally
breaks your little group.{end_wait}
